per_channel_steps: normalize power across local spatial frequency bins
descriptor_summary: per-frequency channel mean and population standard deviation; L2 normalized
support_query_protocol: fixed whole-image split: 1 support image and 20 development query images; existing 1000 filename-coordinate-unit buffer; coordinate units are not independently verified
spatial_cam: same frozen block-24 patch tokens; support foreground/background cosine prototype difference
frequency_cam: mean cosine prototype difference across 4, 6, and 8 token local FFT descriptors
fusion: equal-weight arithmetic mean of spatial and frequency CAM probabilities

fusion_cam_outputs.raw_array: One full-resolution float32 .npy probability map per query, range [0, 1]

interpretation: The fixed benchmark was previously used for development; all resulting query-mask metrics are development results, not an independent test.
background_class: All mask-zero pixels are a single class; no bare-soil/cropland subtype labels are used or required.
